title: VTA DIDs — Keys Revoke — payload
description: Revoke a key of a key-role identity for compromise: it leaves its role in one change without overlap, its compromise time is published as the method's `revoked` value, and a replacement takes its place where needed. For `update`, the authority moves to the routine successor (`scope: key`) or, when the VTA's boundary may be compromised, to the recovery key (`scope: boundary`).

did.description: The key-role identity, by DID (for a `did:scid` identity, the DID without `src`).

verificationMethod.description: The compromised key. REQUIRED for every role but `update`; refused for `update`.

compromisedSince.description: The compromise time (VTI-KEY-121). Err early; where it cannot be established, the time the key was first published. Not later than the request's `issuedAt`.

scope.description: `update` only, REQUIRED there (CONVENTIONS.md §9.4). `key` — one routine key is exposed; the VTA moves to its routine successor. `boundary` — the VTA's protection boundary may be compromised; only the recovery key may authorize the change, and every key the boundary held is replaced. `boundary` is for a level-3 identity only (`vta/dids:assuranceLevelMismatch` below it): a level-2 identity whose VTA may be compromised is deactivated and replaced (CONVENTIONS.md §9.4).

replacement.description: Mint a replacement in the same role, in the same change. Absent means: replace only if the role would otherwise be empty, with the revoked key's algorithm. Not for `update` or `authenticator`.

recoveryCommitment.description: REQUIRED with `scope: boundary`: the fresh recovery key that replaces the one the change uses.

recoveryProof.description: `scope: boundary` only: the recovery custodian's proof over `preview.recoverySigning.unsignedChange`, in the method profile's form.

expectedVersionId.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition: the version identifier (method profile §3) the caller based this change on, for example `keys/list`'s `versionId`. The VTA MUST refuse with `vta/dids:versionConflict` if the identity has moved past it. Not optional for anything a person looked at.

dryRun.description: Compute and return the preview without writing anything but the plan (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1). Absent reads as false.

previewId.description: Apply exactly the plan a previous dry run of this same request returned, or nothing (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1); what every approval is bound to.

reason.description: Why the change is being made, for the audit trail and for the other approvers. Never published.

Response.title: VTA DIDs — Keys Revoke — response payload

preview.description: Present when `outcome` is `preview`, `pendingApproval` or `awaitingRecoveryProof`: the plan, and what an approval is bound to.

newVersionId.description: Present when `outcome` is `applied`: the version identifier of the change. Pass it as the next change's `expectedVersionId`.

keys.description: Every key whose state this change sets or would set, after the change.
